newsitem.title: UK: BOC rises amid upbeat comment on results.
newsitem.headline: BOC rises amid upbeat comment on results.

text.p: Shares in BOC Group Plc were squeezed higher on Friday, adding to yesterdays gains amid positive press comment on the industrial and healthcare gases group's first-quarter results.
The stock was up 24-1/2p at 984 by 0935 GMT in thin volume of 165,602 shares, after rising on Thursday by 21-1/2p.
Market-makers said a shortage of stock in the market exaggerated the move.
In a comment on yesterday's two percent rise in pre-tax profits to 103 million stg, the Financial Times said BOC "offers solid promise in an otherwise volatile and uncertain sector".

The paper said strong sales increases were guaranteed in the gases business in coming years. Despite trading at a slight premium to the rest of the chemicals sector in terms of its prospective price-earnings ratio, "the shares have some attractions," it said.
